description: Replace the materials recorded against a job - what was actually used on site. This is a whole-list replace, not an append: anything you leave out is dropped. Read the current list first with hcp_get_job_input_materials.

materials.description: The complete list the job should end up with

unit_cost_dollars.description: In dollars; converted to cents on the way out

uuid.description: Include to keep an existing row; omit to add one

name: hcp_update_job_input_materials
